summary: Full **Organigrama** (Assemblea → Junta directiva + 7 áreas + 40 cargos): private `/api/v1/org-chart`, CRUD `/areas` & `/org-roles`, `PUT /org-roles/{id}/holders`, public RGPD-filtered `/api/v1/public/org-chart`, and hierarchical web UI with person/vacant filters and board editing. **Server + web (wasmJs) + Astro public API**.
overview:
First functional Fase 2 slice. Exposes the v0.2 organigrama seeded by `platform-schema-v02` (`V2__seed.sqm`) through private and public APIs and renders the interactive hierarchy in the management webapp.

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §4.4, §5.5, §6.7 (organigrama), §6.8 (`/public/org-chart`), §7.4 (Organigrama), §10.1–10.2, §12.1 · `docs/decisiones.md`.

**Prerequisites**
- `platform-schema-v02` (`areas`, `org_roles`, `org_role_holders`, 8 areas + 40 roles seed).
- `platform-core-contract` (`Area`, `OrgRole`, `OrgChartResponse`, `PublicOrgChartResponse`, `PatchField`).
- `platform-server-auth` + `platform-web-shell` + `platform-openapi-deploy`.
- **Note on holder picker:** assigning holders in the UI searches active members via `GET /api/v1/users?status=active` (implemented in `spec-05-members`; until `spec-05-members` merges, the picker accepts a lightweight `GET /api/v1/org-chart/candidates` or is wired directly to `GET /api/v1/users` once `spec-05-members` lands — recommended order: ship server CRUD of `spec-05-members` before or alongside the UI holder picker).

**Key business & RGPD rules**
- Only **one** `Area` can have `kind = board` (enforced by partial unique index → `409 duplicate`). `Area.slug` is unique globally; `(OrgRole.areaId, OrgRole.name)` is unique per area (`409 duplicate`).
- Deleting an `Area` that still has `org_roles` fails with `409 in_use` (`ON DELETE RESTRICT`). Deleting the `board` area is forbidden (`409 in_use` / `422`).
- `PUT /api/v1/org-roles/{id}/holders` validates `version` (`409 version_conflict`), verifies every `holderId` refers to an existing non-`deleted` user (`422 validation_failed` otherwise), deduplicates IDs, replaces `org_role_holders` in one transaction, and increments `org_roles.version`.
- Private `GET /api/v1/org-chart` returns Junta first (`kind = board`), then areas ordered by `sort_order, name`, with each area's roles ordered by `sort_order, name` and holder summaries `{id, name, lastNames, nickname, avatar}` (includes minors internally per `decisiones.md`). `notes` on `Area` is included **only** for `board`/`admin` (`null`/omitted for `member`/`technical`).
- Public `GET /api/v1/public/org-chart` (`Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`): returns all areas (`id`, `name`, `slug`, `kind`, `order`) and roles (`id`, `areaId`, `name`, `isLead`, `order`, `holders`) where `holders` includes **only** users with `status = active && consent.publicProfile == true && !isMinor`. Never exposes `vacant` boolean or hidden holder counts (so callers cannot infer whether a role is held by a minor or non-public member).

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :server:test :app:shared:jvmTest :app:webApp:compileKotlinWasmJs` passes.
- `GET /api/v1/org-chart` returns 8 seeded areas and 40 roles; `notes` omitted for `member`/`technical`, present for `board`/`admin`.
- `GET /api/v1/public/org-chart` never exposes minors, `deleted`/inactive users, or users without `consent.publicProfile`.
- Permission matrix test verifies: `anonymous` (public only, 401 private), `member` & `technical` (read private, 403 write), `board` & `admin` (full CRUD).
- UI at `/organigrama` renders Assemblea → navy Junta → 3-column area grid, clickable KPI strip (Àrees, Càrrecs, Vacants, Persones amb càrrec), person filter with summary text («Toni ocupa: …»), «Només vacants» toggle, and board right-side drawers (`Gestiona les àrees`, `Edita l'àrea`, `Edita el càrrec` / holders).
- `OpenApiRouteSyncTest` passes.
shared_ui_policy: All screens, ViewModels, and repositories live in `:app:shared` `commonMain`. `:app:webApp` only hosts the wasm shell. Android/desktop/JS out of v1 scope.
out_of_scope:
- User CRUD & member archiving (`spec-05-members`, which removes archived/deleted users from `org_role_holders`).
- Role-based permissions derived from `OrgRole` (§4.2 future phase).
- Android, desktop, JS, iOS clients.

auth.client: Bearer JWT via `SessionManager`. UI checks `org-chart:read` (all authenticated roles) and `board`/`admin` write actions via permissions.
auth.server: Private read: `member`, `technical`, `board`, `admin` (with `Area.notes` restricted to `board`/`admin`). Write (`POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE` areas & org-roles, `PUT` holders): `board`, `admin`. Public read: anonymous.

components.name: OrgChart.sq
components.usage: SQLDelight queries for `areas`, `org_roles`, `org_role_holders` joined with `users` + `stored_files`, count roles per area, and version-checked updates.

components.name: OrgChartService
components.usage: Transactional business logic: build private/public org-chart trees, CRUD areas & org-roles with optimistic locking (`409 version_conflict`), uniqueness mapping (`409 duplicate`), `409 in_use` on deleting area with roles, and `replaceHolders` validating non-deleted users.

components.name: OrgChartMapper
components.usage: Audience mapping: `members` (omits `Area.notes`), `board` (includes `Area.notes`), and `public` (filters `holders` by `status=active && publicProfile && !isMinor`, omits `vacant`/`notes`/`whatsappGroup`/`description`).

components.name: OrgChartRoutes
components.notes: Sets `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300` on public route.

components.name: OrgChartRepository + OrgChartViewModel
components.usage: Loads org chart, computes summary metrics (`areaCount`, `roleCount`, `vacantCount`, `peopleWithRolesCount`), manages person highlight filter, «Només vacants» toggle, board CRUD + reorder + holder assignment, and `409 version_conflict` reload dialog.

components.name: OrgChartScreen + Area/Role/Holders drawers
components.usage: Route `/organigrama` matching mockups: `SectionHeader` + `+ EDITA L'ORGANIGRAMA` CTA (`board`/`admin`), 4 KPI cards (`Àrees`, `Càrrecs`, `Vacants` cream/red, `Persones amb càrrec`), `Filtra per persona` input + `Només vacants` switch, hierarchy (`Assemblea de socis` dark pill → navy `Junta directiva` bar with 4 columns → 3-column area grid with color dot, vacant count, `EDITA` button, `★` lead marker, holder initials+name or cream `Vacant` row), and right-side drawers (`Gestiona les àrees`, `Edita l'àrea` incl. `meetingFrequency` & yellow `Notes internes`, and `Edita el càrrec` / holder picker).

structure:
Vertical slice flow:

```text
Web /organigrama (OrgChartScreen → OrgChartViewModel → OrgChartRepository → MuixerangaApi)
  ↕ JSON over HTTPS
Server OrgChartRoutes → OrgChartService → OrgChartMapper → OrgChart.sq (SQLite v0.2)
  ↑
Astro public site → GET /api/v1/public/org-chart (Cache-Control: public, max-age=300)
```

sections.title: Public RGPD filtering (§5.5 & §6.8)
sections.description: `GET /api/v1/public/org-chart` exposes the full organizational structure (Junta + areas ordered by `order`, all roles ordered by `order` with `name` and `isLead`), but filters `holders` strictly to active adult members with `consent.publicProfile == true`.
sections.behavior: Never include `vacant`, `notes`, `whatsappGroup`, `description`, or any count of omitted holders on the public response. Compute `isMinor` in `Europe/Madrid` timezone from `birth_date`.

sections.title: UI hierarchy, filtering & board drawers (§7.4 & mockups)
sections.description: Top KPI strip shows 4 cards inside the light-grey container: `Àrees`, `Càrrecs`, `Vacants` (cream fill, red count), and `Persones amb càrrec`. Filter toolbar provides `Filtra per persona` and a `Només vacants` toggle switch.
sections.behavior: Selecting/filtering a person highlights every role they hold, dims other rows, and displays a summary strip («<Nom> ocupa: <càrrec 1>; <càrrec 2>»). Toggling `Només vacants` filters each area card to display only vacant role rows. Users with `board`/`admin` see `+ EDITA L'ORGANIGRAMA` (opening the `Gestiona les àrees` right-side drawer to add/reorder/change status/delete areas), per-area `EDITA` buttons (opening `Edita l'àrea` right-side drawer with Nom, Descripció, Estat, Color, Grup de WhatsApp, Freqüència de reunió, and yellow-accented Notes internes), and role-click editing to update role details and assign holders (`PUT /org-roles/{id}/holders`).

endpoints.name: Get full org chart
endpoints.notes: Single call returning Junta + areas + roles + holder summaries (includes minors internally; `notes` only for `board`/`admin`).

endpoints.name: Delete area
endpoints.notes: `board`/`admin`. `204`, or `409 in_use` if area has roles or `kind = board`.

endpoints.name: Public org chart
endpoints.notes: Anonymous, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`. Public adult holders only.

persistence: Uses SQLite v0.2 tables `areas`, `org_roles`, `org_role_holders`, `users`, `stored_files` via `OrgChart.sq`. No new migrations.
